summary: The ChangePassword functionality allows users to securely update their password in compliance with organizational policies. It validates new password fields for complexity, ensures policy agreement, and displays warnings or errors as needed. Password changes trigger system updates and guide users through a structured workflow, with client-side and server-side validation, error handling, and policy acknowledgement.
purpose: Enable users to change their password, enforce password security requirements and ensure policy agreement before permitting password updates.

fields.name: txtNewPassword2
fields.description: Repeat of new password for confirmation.

fields.name: chkPolicy
fields.description: User must check to agree to policies.

workflows.name: Change Password
steps: User enters current password in txtCurrentPassword.
User enters new password in txtNewPassword.
User re-enters new password in txtNewPassword2.
User reviews policy text and checks chkPolicy if agreed.
User submits the form via cmdChangePassword.
System validates fields and policy checkbox.
If validation passes, system updates password via Security.ChangePassword.
System displays success message and redirects to Tools.aspx.
If validation fails, error messages are shown with details.

workflows.name: Cancel Change
steps: System redirects to Tools.aspx without changes.

business_rules: New password must be at least 12 characters.
New password must contain at least one digit.
New password must contain at least one symbol.
New password must contain both upper and lower case letters.
New password must not be identical to the current password.
User must confirm new password by entering it twice.
User must agree to the policies (chkPolicy checked) before changing password.
validations: RegularExpressionValidator for digit and letter combination.
RegularExpressionValidator for upper and lower case letters.
CompareValidator to ensure txtNewPassword and txtNewPassword2 match.
CompareValidator to ensure new password and current password are not identical.
CustomValidator to ensure policy agreement (chkPolicy checked).
calculations: PasswordStrength indicator evaluates password quality (weak, average, good) based on character requirements.
conditions: If validation fails, user remains on the page with error messages.
If validation passes, password is changed and user is redirected.
If user does not agree to policies, change is not allowed.
system_behavior: Displays error and warning panels for feedback.
Registers relevant JavaScript for client-side validation.
Default button set to cmdChangePassword for convenience.
Focus set to current password textbox on load.
Policy text fetched and displayed on page load.
Processes page messages and warnings post-validation.
dependencies: HSPnet.DataLayer for Help and Staff entities.
Resources for error and UI messages.
Client-side JavaScript functions for additional validation.
exceptions: If password change fails, error list is displayed to user.
If password does not meet requirements, specific validation errors returned.
If user does not check policy agreement, error is thrown and change denied.
If session or system errors occur, user is redirected or error handled.
